exposure: Delivery location (fetal center vs. referring physician's hospital)
In utero open fetal myelomeningocele repair
cohort: 88 patients who underwent in utero open fetal myelomeningocele repair at a single fetal center between 2011-2019
finding: The study found no significant differences in maternal or neonatal outcomes between patients who delivered at the fetal center where the fetal intervention was performed and those who delivered at the referring physician's hospital, suggesting it is safe for patients to travel home for delivery after open fetal myelomeningocele repair.
